ValidationRule.description: If Case Participation is set and Case Record is set, then Case Record must equal the Case Record associated with the Case Participation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( Case_Participation__c != null && Case_Record__c != null && Case_Participation__r.Case_Record__c != Case_Record__c, true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case Record must equal the Case Record associated with the selected Case Participation.
